caption:
When the canopy closes overhead, mountain biking in Costa Rica becomes a quiet conversation with the terrain. Two narrow tracks cut through damp earth and gravel, framed by mountain forest that brushes your shoulders as you drop in. No engines, no traffic—just the rhythm of tires on dirt and cool air through the trees. Send this to the friend who would ride this descent with you.
